summary: The audit checks 45 units of graduate coursework, at least 36 of them letter-graded Math courses numbered 120 and above (units from MATH 360 do not count toward the degree at all, and Math courses below 120 do not count), with at least 18 of those units numbered 200-297. Checked by hand: the Director of Graduate Studies approves your course program before your first quarter, and you need a 3.0 GPA in your Math courses and, separately, in your 200-level courses.
